I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats and that nothing else will change, since she said no action was needed.

I didn't repeat the number she posted in #north-team, because people in #north-random may not be able to see that channel. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so 100 was fine to confirm here. She'd already posted it in this channel herself.
